Your Company Administrator is the only individual able to reset your password. # Strategic money moves: 3 ways to help strengthen your portfolio in 2026. As markets shift and uncertainty persists, investors should consider small, disciplined adjustments to their portfolio strategy in 2026. We outline three smart moves to help strengthen your investment portfolio for the year ahead. *   With the potential for additional interest rate cuts ahead, consider extending bond maturities and reducing excess cash to capture yield and strengthen your portfolio. Here are three investment strategies that may help strengthen your portfolio for the year ahead, including how to think about portfolio rebalancing and how to diversify your portfolio for 2026 in a practical, disciplined way.

Six portfolio strategy ideas for 2026

Global growth is broadening, and business activity is picking up. The Chief Investment Office (CIO) believes 2026 will be shaped by supportive fiscal conditions, rising earnings and an accelerating AI‑industrial investment cycle. “Recently we’ve experienced above-average volatility across the markets,” says Chris Hyzy, Chief Investment Officer for Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank. “This volatility has pressured metals prices and high-growth mega-cap shares as well. In the context of all of this, we’re focusing on six key portfolio considerations we believe matter most this year.”
